stem_book: Which plot represents an exothermic reaction? (Each option is a graph of H vs Time, R = reactants, P = products.) (a) R high, line sloping down to P low (b) R low, line sloping up to P high (c) R and P at the same level with a hump between them (d) R and P at the same level with a dip between them
key: a R high, sloping down to P low
derived: a R high, sloping down to P low
correct_answer: a R high, sloping down to P low
work: Exothermic ⇒ H_P < H_R ⇒ enthalpy falls from R to P (graph a)
